texas-county-outages.json.notes: Jikun Liu, 4TU.ResearchData, version 1. All 28,448 county/time records retained (254 counties, 112 three-hour timestamps, Feb 11-24 2021). Only county, time, outage_count and temp retained; numeric values preserved. Source DATASETS.md states timestamps are naive, with no timezone specified; do not label them UTC or align to EIA without verification. It calls outage_count outages/events, without confirming customers. Temperature is described only as degrees; Celsius/Fahrenheit is not specified. No unit conversion or imputation.

texas-counties.geojson.notes: U.S. Census Bureau cb_2020_us_county_20m, all 254 Texas counties (STATEFP 48). Source is already generalized to 1:20,000,000. Retained GEOID, NAME, STATEFP, and all polygon vertices, rounded to 4 decimal places; rings reversed to GeoJSON exterior orientation. NAD83 longitude/latitude treated as WGS84 at this display scale; no datum transform. Not for engineering measurements.
